1879059884.Skill_Desc: Makes a full AoE attack, inflicting heavy damage.\n\nThis attack never misses on level opponents.

1879073196.Skill_Desc: Your companion hampers archers, inhibiting their ability to fire and enraging them.

1879090220.Skill_Desc: Throw rock at far away things. Hurt things near far thing. Sometimes, make things bleed after.

1879096876.Skill_Desc: Your companion makes a wild and damaging attack.

1879109292.Skill_Desc: The potency of Rune-keepers' writings is not hindered by repetition. This skill is hard to resist.

1879159980.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from Celegdes, the vendor of the Wardens of Annúminas.

1879197996.Skill_Desc: Your Companion will instantly return to your side.

1879229996.Skill_Desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Stangard in Eorlsmead.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879230252.Skill_Desc:
You attack your enemy from every shadow, dealing devastating damage. 
 
 <rgb=#FF7700>Agonizing Maul becomes Sudden Maul. 
 
 Raking Claws becomes Bestial Claws. 
 
 Brutal Fangs becomes Shadow Fangs. 
 
 Eye Gash becomes Eye Gouge. 
 
 Snap becomes Snap! 
 
 Howl of Aggression becomes Howl from the Shadow. 
 
 Pack Flayers becomes Shadow Pack. 
 
</rgb>  <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind. 
 
 Increased damage from Stealth.
 
 Sudden Maul, Bestial Claws, and Pounce function as they are from stealth and cannot be Blocked, Parried or Evaded.</rgb>

1879230636.Skill_Desc: You mark your territory, decreasing up to four enemies mitigations. Upon exiting your marked territory, your enemies take a reduced version of the debuff.

1879231404.Skill_Desc: A powerful javelin deals direct damage.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879241644.Skill_Desc:
You unleash the culmination of your musical efforts into a harmful blast of light-based damage affecting nearby enemies and restoring a fair amount of power to you and nearby friendly targets and war-steeds.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#00FFDD>Active Anthems add enhanced effects to the Coda.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Anthems from Minstrel.</rgb>

1879244844.Skill_Desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Rohirrim Discipline your defensive capacity is increased.

1879250988.Skill_Desc: A full-force strike against a target that has the potential to inspire your efforts against your enemies.

1879270572.Skill_Desc: Places a snare to slow the enemy and cause damage over time.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879275436.Skill_Desc: Places a Rune-stone upon the ground that deals damage-over-time to nearby enemies.\n\nThe Rune-stone will persist for 11s.

1879288364.Skill_Desc: A resolute strike, dealing strong Light Damage over time.

1879305388.Skill_Desc: Treebeard smashes the ground with one heavy swing of his arm.

1879314860.Skill_Desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Men of Dol Amroth, you're able to quickly return to Dol Amroth in western Gondor. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879338924.Skill_Desc: Summons a friendly injured bat. It will 'walk it off.'
1879338924.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available to barter from Adúrhid Quartermasters

1879391404.Skill_Desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879411756.Skill_Desc: Summons a loveable wild donkey travelling companion.
1879411756.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available to barter from Ikorbâni Quartermasters

1879448748.Skill_Desc: Summons a friendly bear cub to keep you company.
1879448748.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available to barter from Celeblír in Rivendell.

1879456428.Skill_Desc: A steed for new beginnings and glorious adventures.
1879456428.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from completing deeds in Cardolan.

1879468972.Skill_Desc: You are able to catch your breath to restore morale and power.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a block or parry response.</rgb>

1879471276.Skill_Desc: A pot filled with a foul-smelling sludge and set alight.

1879480620.Skill_Desc: Summons a friendly crab who loves to surprise friends and strangers alike with a surprisingly realistic menacing countenance.
1879480620.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from the Skirmishes -- Ill Omens event.

1879485996.Skill_Desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879489324.Skill_Desc: Your companion is able to bring you back from the brink of defeat. If you would have suffered a killing blow while active, your companion will lend you their will, restoring your Power and Morale.

1879490988.Skill_Desc: Summons a fine cow to proudly display.
1879490988.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Farmers Faire Festival.

1879495340.Skill_Desc: A Memory of Purification can be used to cleanse corruptions and strike down gertheryg.

1879524140.Skill_Desc: This blight mushroom looks especially potent and dangerous. Best leave it alone.
1879524140.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: An unsettling relic from the depths of Utug-bûr
